observations: Photos show a sewing/weaving machine frame/stand with multiple metal legs and a base platform.
There are rectangular openings/cut-outs on the top surface (looks like a worktable top).
The base has a grid/footplate area and a small mechanism/rod assembly near the front (details unclear).
No motor, handwheel, belt/pulley, or full machine head is clearly visible in these photos.
The seller text says 'Sewing and Weaving machine legs' and provides a location (Ibadan) and a number, but the photos mainly show the legs/stand.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show a metal stand/legs and top worktable frame consistent with machine legs/stand.
The amount is in the seller’s words only; no price list or photo with price is provided here.
Location is only in the seller’s text; photos do not confirm the city.

risks.risk: What is included may be only the legs/stand, not the complete sewing/weaving machine (missing machine head, drive, and accessories).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full machine (top head + drive/handwheel/motor) and a photo of everything included laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as stand/legs only (worst case: no working machine).

risks.risk: Condition/straightness: legs or frame may be bent or welded poorly, affecting stability.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of all leg joints/welds plus a short video showing the stand placed on flat ground and not wobbling.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as used/possibly needing repair (worst case: wobble/loose joints).

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion and hidden damage under the base.
risks.proof: Ask for underside photos of the base and legs (especially corners and joints).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as having normal wear with possible corrosion (worst case: needs cleaning/maintenance).

risks.risk: Compatibility: the stand may not fit the specific sewing/weaving machine model you have.
risks.proof: Ask for the mounting hole sizes/spacing (measurements) or a photo of the stand attached to the machine head.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as generic/uncertain fit (worst case: buyer may need adaptation).

proof_requests: Confirm exactly what’s included: legs/stand only vs full sewing/weaving machine (ask for a full set photo).
Send close-up photos of welds/joints and any missing parts.
Send a short video of the stand on flat ground showing it doesn’t wobble.
Provide mounting/attachment measurements (hole spacing) or a photo of the stand connected to the machine head.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a sewing/weaving machine stand/legs, but they do not prove whether it’s complete or how stable/compatible it is. Missing inclusion and condition details prevent a confident worst-case price.
